A conversation, without pressure

Why understand your options first?

Every patient’s condition is different. Learning about available procedures can help you have a more informed conversation with your doctor.

  • Understand differences between procedures
  • Ask what may influence recovery and costs
  • Discuss risks and limitations
  • Prepare questions for your consultation
Is this for you?

Who is this guide for?

01 / UNDERSTAND

You want clearer information

You have been diagnosed with piles or have symptoms you want to discuss with a clinician.

02 / COMPARE

You are considering a procedure

03 / PREPARE

You want to plan a consultation

You would like to organize your questions before speaking with a doctor.

Why choose an informed approach?

The right treatment depends on your diagnosis, the severity of your condition, your medical history, and your doctor’s assessment. Laser treatment is not necessarily the best choice for everyone.

Deepsara aims to help patients understand their options and make informed decisions with appropriate medical guidance.

Bleeding? Do not wait for a guide.

Rectal bleeding should not automatically be assumed to be piles. Seek medical assessment. Heavy or non-stop bleeding or severe pain needs urgent medical care.

Your questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

Is the guide free?

Yes. The guide is intended to be provided free of charge. Existing patient information is available to read now without registration.

Does reading the guide mean I need surgery?

No. It is educational and does not mean you need surgery or any particular treatment.

Will it tell me which procedure is right for me?

It explains general considerations. A qualified clinician must assess your condition to recommend an appropriate option.

Do I have to book a consultation?

No. Reading or requesting a guide does not commit you to an appointment.
